description: Looks up list prices for LLMs (USD per million input, output and cached input tokens, and context size), image models (USD per image by quality and size) and video models (USD per second by resolution), with each price's source page, the date prices were checked and any announced API shutdown.

kind.description: llm for text models priced per token, image per image, video per second

query.description: A model id such as 'gpt-4o' (only exact id matches, if any), or words that must all appear in the id, name or provider, such as 'claude sonnet'. Omitted: every model.

name: model_prices

cachedInputPerMtokUsd.description: LLMs: USD per million cached input tokens, where offered

inputPerMtokUsd.description: LLMs: USD per million input tokens

outputPerMtokUsd.description: LLMs: USD per million output tokens

page.description: The page on this site that lists this model

priceChanged.description: Date this model's price last changed; null if unchanged since tracking began

priceChecked.description: Date this model's price was last confirmed against its source (YYYY-MM-DD)

variants.description: Image and video models: price per quality, size or resolution

permalink.description: A page on this site that shows this result, for a person to open

pricesChecked.description: Date of the last full price check. Each model also has its own priceChecked and priceChanged.

title: AI model prices
